text: First, find the net components: x, East–West, and y, North–South, using running totals. Then apply Pythagoras' theorem: d equals the square root of x squared plus y squared. If one component is zero, the distance is just the other component. And watch for the triples that appear constantly in exams: 3-4-5, 6-8-10, 5-12-13 and 8-15-17, and their multiples.
